lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਜਗਤੁ ਮੈ ਕੋ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੋ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: nij kar dekhio jagat mai ko kaahoo ko naahi ||
lines.translation: I had looked upon the world as my own, but no one belongs to anyone else.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਥਿਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਤਿਹ ਰਾਖੋ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੪੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak thir har bhagat hai tih raakho man maahi ||48||
lines.translation: O Nanak, only devotional worship of the Lord is permanent; enshrine this in your mind. ||48||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਗ ਰਚਨਾ ਸਭ ਝੂਠ ਹੈ ਜਾਨਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਰੇ ਮੀਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: jag rachanaa sabh jhooth hai jaan lehu re meet ||
lines.translation: The world and its affairs are totally false; know this well, my friend.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾ ਰਹੈ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲੂ ਕੀ ਭੀਤਿ ॥੪੯॥
lines.transliteration: kahi naanak thir naa rahai jiu baaloo kee bheet ||49||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, it is like a wall of sand; it shall not endure. ||49||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਗਇਓ ਰਾਵਨੁ ਗਇਓ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਬਹੁ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam gaio raavan gaio jaa kau bahu paravaar ||
lines.translation: Raam Chand passed away, as did Raawan, even though he had lots of relatives.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਥਿਰੁ ਕਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਸੁਪਨੇ ਜਿਉ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੫੦॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak thir kachh nahee supane jiu sa(n)saar ||50||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, nothing lasts forever; the world is like a dream. ||50||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਿੰਤਾ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਜੀਐ ਜੋ ਅਨਹੋਨੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: chi(n)taa taa kee keejeeai jo anahonee hoi ||
lines.translation: People become anxious, when something unexpected happens.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥੫੧॥
lines.transliteration: ihu maarag sa(n)saar ko naanak thir nahee koi ||51||
lines.translation: This is the way of the world, O Nanak; nothing is stable or permanent. ||51||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਸੋ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਹੈ ਪਰੋ ਆਜੁ ਕੈ ਕਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo upajio so binas hai paro aaj kai kaal ||
lines.translation: Whatever has been created shall be destroyed; everyone shall perish, today or tomorrow.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਲੇ ਛਾਡਿ ਸਗਲ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥੫੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak har gun gaai le chhaad sagal ja(n)jaal ||52||
lines.translation: O Nanak, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and give up all other entanglements. ||52||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: doharaa ||
lines.translation: Dohraa:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਲੁ ਛੁਟਕਿਓ ਬੰਧਨ ਪਰੇ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਤ ਉਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bal chhutakio ba(n)dhan pare kachhoo na hot upaai ||
lines.translation: My strength is exhausted, and I am in bondage; I cannot do anything at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਬ ਓਟ ਹਰਿ ਗਜ ਜਿਉ ਹੋਹੁ ਸਹਾਇ ॥੫੩॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak ab ot har gaj jiu hohu sahaai ||53||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, now, the Lord is my Support; He will help me, as He did the elephant. ||53||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਬੰਧਨ ਛੁਟੇ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਤ ਉਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bal hoaa ba(n)dhan chhute sabh kichh hot upaai ||
lines.translation: My strength has been restored, and my bonds have been broken; now, I can do everything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਮਰੈ ਹਾਥ ਮੈ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਹੋਤ ਸਹਾਇ ॥੫੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sabh kichh tumarai haath mai tum hee hot sahaai ||54||
lines.translation: Nanak: everything is in Your hands, Lord; You are my Helper and Support. ||54||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਗ ਸਖਾ ਸਭਿ ਤਜਿ ਗਏ ਕੋਊ ਨ ਨਿਬਹਿਓ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)g sakhaa sabh taj gae kooo na nibahio saath ||
lines.translation: My associates and companions have all deserted me; no one remains with me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹ ਬਿਪਤਿ ਮੈ ਟੇਕ ਏਕ ਰਘੁਨਾਥ ॥੫੫॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak ih bipat mai tek ek raghunaath ||55||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, in this tragedy, the Lord alone is my Support. ||55||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਾਧੂ ਰਹਿਓ ਰਹਿਓ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam rahio saadhoo rahio rahio gur gobi(n)d ||
lines.translation: The Naam remains; the Holy Saints remain; the Guru, the Lord of the Universe, remains.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹ ਜਗਤ ਮੈ ਕਿਨ ਜਪਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤੁ ॥੫੬॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak ih jagat mai kin japio gur ma(n)t ||56||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, how rare are those who chant the Guru's Mantra in this world. ||56||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰ ਮੈ ਗਹਿਓ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਮ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam ur mai gahio jaa kai sam nahee koi ||
lines.translation: I have enshrined the Lord's Name within my heart; there is nothing equal to it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸੰਕਟ ਮਿਟੈ ਦਰਸੁ ਤੁਹਾਰੋ ਹੋਇ ॥੫੭॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jih simarat sa(n)kat mitai daras tuhaaro hoi ||57||1||
lines.translation: Meditating in remembrance on it, my troubles are taken away; I have received the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||57||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਦਾਵਣੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: mu(n)daavanee mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Mundaavanee, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਥਾਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਤਿੰਨਿ ਵਸਤੂ ਪਈਓ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: thaal vich ti(n)n vasatoo paeeo sat sa(n)tokh veechaaro ||
lines.translation: Upon this Plate, three things have been placed: Truth, Contentment and Contemplation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਾ ਪਇਓ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਭਸੁ ਅਧਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit naam thaakur kaa paio jis kaa sabhas adhaaro ||
lines.translation: The Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of our Lord and Master, has been placed upon it as well; it is the Support of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਖਾਵੈ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਭੁੰਚੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਉਧਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: je ko khaavai je ko bhu(n)chai tis kaa hoi udhaaro ||
lines.translation: One who eats it and enjoys it shall be saved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹ ਵਸਤੁ ਤਜੀ ਨਹ ਜਾਈ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਰਖੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: eh vasat tajee nah jaaee nit nit rakh ur dhaaro ||
lines.translation: This thing can never be forsaken; keep this always and forever in your mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਮ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਚਰਨ ਲਗਿ ਤਰੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਸਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tam sa(n)saar charan lag tareeai sabh naanak braham pasaaro ||1||
lines.translation: The dark world-ocean is crossed over, by grasping the Feet of the Lord; O Nanak, it is all the extension of God. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾਤੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੈਨੋ ਜੋਗੁ ਕੀਤੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: teraa keetaa jaato naahee maino jog keetoee ||
lines.translation: I have not appreciated what You have done for me, Lord; only You can make me worthy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਨਿਰਗੁਣਿਆਰੇ ਕੋ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਆਪੇ ਤਰਸੁ ਪਇਓਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai niraguniaare ko gun naahee aape taras paioee ||
lines.translation: I am unworthy - I have no worth or virtues at all. You have taken pity on me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਰਸੁ ਪਇਆ ਮਿਹਰਾਮਤਿ ਹੋਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: taras paiaa miharaamat hoee satigur sajan miliaa ||
lines.translation: You took pity on me, and blessed me with Your Mercy, and I have met the True Guru, my Friend.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾਂ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਥੀਵੈ ਹਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam milai taa(n) jeevaa(n) tan man theevai hariaa ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, if I am blessed with the Naam, I live, and my body and mind blossom forth. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗ ਮਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag maalaa ||
lines.translation: Raag Maalaa:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗ ਏਕ ਸੰਗਿ ਪੰਚ ਬਰੰਗਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag ek sa(n)g pa(n)ch bara(n)gan ||
lines.translation: Each Raga has five wives,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਅਲਾਪਹਿ ਆਠਉ ਨੰਦਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)g alaapahi aathau na(n)dan ||
lines.translation: and eight sons, who emit distinctive notes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਥਮ ਰਾਗ ਭੈਰਉ ਵੈ ਕਰਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pratham raag bhairau vai karahee ||
lines.translation: In the first place is Raag Bhairao.
